lines.en: label dormwarsfive5:
scene sky
A short while later, Imani begins rounding up each straggling girl and sending them over to the library for the next competition.
Miku, who initially attempts to hide behind me in a rare act of non-sexual submission, is one of the first to be culled — followed by Yasu and her unofficial caretaker.
Eventually, it’s just Makoto and me left in the cafeteria. And while she absolutely would have sex with me right now (and probably wants to), I figure I should save that for later.
Would it be both nice and fitting to copulate with the student council president on my first day back to school in god God knows how long? Of course.
But that also runs the risk of having her get in trouble if we’re caught. Which is a thing that-
Actually, I doubt she’d care much at this point.
But that’s because she’s turning into me. And that’s about 90%% my fault and 10%% the world’s for throwing her into a situation she can’t escape from.
Which is...also coincidentally what I have done.
Either way, the two of us begin to head over to the library for what I’m sure will be the worst trivia contest of all time. But I stop her several steps in by grabbing her hand.
She looks up at me, confused. And I look down at her, also confused.
But then I lean down and kiss her and things make a little more sense.
: Wha-
: I’m sorry I can’t be here to suffer with you as much as you want me to be.
: I’m too busy just suffering on my own now.
: Hah...
: Is it more because you can’t live with the things you’ve done? Or because you know you can’t escape them in a world that won’t stop reminding you?
: Both.
: I have a few less regrets when it comes to you, though.
: Oh? Is that because I told you you shouldn’t feel bad about having sex with me since we’ve known each other for probably millions of years now?
: Not really. I just know I have you tightly secured to an infinite leash now. And I like that.
: Hm. Well, I was hoping to be your lover if this all boils over. But I guess being your dog isn’t as bad as being forgotten.
She kisses me this time, but she needs to grab my collar to pull me down to her level for it.
: Come on, Sensei. We need to go watch a train wreck.
scene mikuyasutrivia1
: At the start of the third game, the score of this year’s Dorm Wars is currently tied with a score of one to one!
: It’s been a heated battle so far! Hasn’t it, Uta?!
scene mikuyasutrivia2
: It sure has, Ayane! It’s only been two hours and we’ve already made one whole omelet and then sat at a table and roleplayed Shrek!
: So not as heated as I made it sound!
: But still heated regardless!
scene mikuyasutrivia3
: Because today is the day that all of us girls will become women.
: Today is the day where weaknesses become strengths! When we learn which floor is truly the most versatile and admirable!
: At least until next year when we do this all over again.
: Exactly.
scene mikuyasutrivia4
: Hi. I have a question.
: Yes, Miku! What’s up?
: Why do you hate me?
: Nobody hates you, Miku!
: Yeah! Like half of the class is being put up against each other in stuff they’re bad at.
: And we’ve already learned through Chika and Kirin’s contest that this can actually be a good thing for you guys!
: Right! Like maybe today will be the inspiration you need to start doing better in school?
: Or maybe I’ll just make myself look like the 2024 Chicago White Sox goin’ up against the Dodgers while Ohtani’s on the mound.
: I wish Io was here. She’d be really proud of you right now. Also, I’m pretty sure this is the second year in a row we’ve brought up Ohtani during a library trivia contest.
: She’d also be here to tell you that Ohtani didn’t pitch in 2024 due to a UCL injury.
: Just do your best, Miku. Complaining will only delay the inevitable at this point.
: Yeah. We’re all rooting for you. And it’s not just because the fate of this contest sort of lies in your hands right now. It’s because we like you.
: Also because the fate of this contest sort of lies in your hands right now.
scene mikuyasutrivia5
: I apologize in advance for my inferior intellect.
scene mikuyasutrivia6
: Well, that was a good start at least. “Inferior” is much bigger word than I’ve come to expect from you.
: One that perfectly encapsulates who we are as human beings in a world that belongs to God.
: Also, I can’t imagine you’re at much of a disadvantage if at all right now.
: Is it just me or is Yasu kind of cute today?
scene mikuyasutrivia7
: Yasu is always cute in a...Yasu way. But if you’re referring to her wardrobe, you can thank a team of professional stylists for that.
: And Molly helped me with my hair. Do you like it, Sensei? Do I look like a normal girl now?
: Yes, and it’s making me very uncomfortable.
: Eyes over here, Dad.
scene mikuyasutrivia8
: I’ll just stare at the ground and be ashamed of myself.
: For what it’s worth, I’m uncomfortable too. And I imagine Nodoka is in the same boat as well given that she is the biggest sex demon of all.
: I wonder if Futaba would hug me?
: Or she’s still hung up on hugs for some reason.
scene mikuyasutrivia9
: The rules of the game are simple — and we’re only going to ask that you answer five total questions correctly before granting your floor the victory.
: Five?! We’ve gotta know five whole things?!
: At least tell me the questions are gonna be from categories we’re good at! Like, ask me somethin’ about soccer! Or One Piece! Pokemon! Anything but math!
: I don’t think we have any math questions, so you don’t have to worry about that.
: Oh, thank the friggin’ lord.
scene mikuyasutrivia10
: So anyway, our first trivia question is about molecular biology and it’s for Miku.
scene mikuyasutrivia11
: AAAAAH!
: Jeez. We’re starting off with something like that already?
: Just out of curiosity, what happens if neither contestant is ever able to answer a single question correctly?
: Then we stay here forever, Maya! And Sensei has to rebuild civilization from the ground up since he’s the only boy in the room.
scene mikuyasutrivia12
: It’s a dirty job, but someone’s gotta do it.
: Start with me. Then also end with me. Because I am all you need and, coincidentally, all you want as well.
: Ahem.
scene mikuyasutrivia13
: Sorry, Miss Imai. That was probably rude of me. You can watch, don’t worry.
: Ayane, just ask the damn question before I have to slap a bitch.
: Miku! What covalent bonds link nucleic acid monomers?
: Miku! What covalent bonds link nucleic acid monomers?
scene mikuyasutrivia14
: Regis, I think I’d like to phone a friend.
scene mikuyasutrivia15
: Okay! So Miku passes and now Yasu gets to go!
: Remember, Yasu — it is okay to not know these things and it is okay to say “pass” if you feel yourself getting stuck.
: Because, based on the question Miku received, we can assume that the hosts are not holding back and will be quizzing you on topics not yet touched upon by-
: What is a duck?
scene mikuyasutrivia16
: ...I beg your pardon?
: Sorry, was I not loud enough? Yasu! What is a duck?!
: The heck is this rigged nonsense?! Y’all are gonna give me a friggin’ testicular biography question and Yasu just needs to tell you what a duck is?!
: This does seem a little unfair, and I’m on Yasu’s team.
: It’s okay, Miku. I’m sure that Yasu’s next question will be difficult and yours will be about describing some other sort of animal.
: Friggin’ better be! I need all the help I can get here!
: Okay, Yasu. Do not squander this opportunity. Answer the question and briskly move onto the next.
: Pass.
scene mikuyasutrivia17
: Pass?!
: Did I make a mistake? You said it was okay to pass if I felt myself getting stuck, Touka.
: She wasn’t asking you for the scientific classification of a duck! She mentioned no genus! You just had to say it was a little wet bird with a little orange beak!
: I wanted to, Touka. But what I struggle to understand is that little bird’s importance in the grand scheme of His divine schedule.
: What if there is more to the duck that I have yet to grasp as but a fledgling myself?
: Would reducing its potential to mere visual characteristics not doom the creature to a life of being misunderstood the way that I, too, have my purpose misconstrued?
: Yes! If that’s what wins us the contest!
scene mikuyasutrivia18
: Wow, Ayane. You were spot-on when you predicted that Yasu would struggle with simple questions like that.
: And you were spot on when you assumed Miku would struggle with difficult questions.
: For what it’s worth, I don’t believe that’s something worth being impressed about.
scene mikuyasutrivia19
: Probably not! But I’m a nice person who says nice things whenever possible!
: Which is why I’ll compliment Miku on her hair before asking her this next question so she doesn’t feel as bad when she gets it wrong.
: Nice hair, Miku! What is the study of knowledge called?
scene mikuyasutrivia20
: Learning!
: Hah...
scene mikuyasutrivia21
: What?! How is that wrong?! Ain’t that the whole point of learning?!
: Technically it...kind of is? But we were looking for the specific study of knowledge. Not a broad description of how learning is the act of absorbing it.
: Can we give her another guess, Uta? Is that okay?
: Imani! Check the rule book!
: There’s nothing about this in the rule book, but I say give her another shot. We might be in here for a while if we don’t.
: Miku! Do you have a second guess?
scene mikuyasutrivia22
: Uhh...well...
: The study of meteors is called meteorology, so...knowledgeology?...Maybe?...
scene mikuyasutrivia23
: The study of meteors is not called meteorology, Miku! Where in the world did you even hear that?!
: The TV obviously! They’re talkin’ about it all the time!
: Because meteorology is the study of weather! You’re probably watching the weather report!
: Are you tellin’ me I’ve been livin’ in fear for nothing?!
: Have you been expecting meteors to fall every time the rain is mentioned?!
: Obviously not, Makoto! The meteors block the rain!
: I feel like we should probably take a point away from Miku now. But she doesn’t have any, so...Yasu!
scene mikuyasutrivia24
: What is a horse?
scene mikuyasutrivia25
: Mm! Touka, this game is too hard! I don’t know how to do it!
: Well, I will be of little assistance here as that is a question without a simple answer. And one that would take years to respond to completely.
: I suggest you pass here as well, Yasu.
scene mikuyasutrivia26
: Uta and Ayane, I apologize for my incessant inadequacy and understand that the sight of me is likely to induce nausea. But could you please ask me an easier question?
: Same here! Just replace the nausea thing with pity or somethin’ cause y’all got them crazy milkers and I ain’t even got a cup to hold ‘em in.
: Ami and Maya get it. Right, girls?
scene mikuyasutrivia27
: Not really. My body is perfect. What envy should I have for those who will grow up with back problems?
: I’ll gladly accept whatever size increase Maya is supposed to get in the future and split it with Miku. With some more help, we may even wind up with B’s.
scene mikuyasutrivia28
: A girl can friggin’ dream. Maybe one day, Ami. Maybe one day.
scene mikuyasutrivia29
: Uta, are you thinking what I’m thinking?
: You mean about boobs? Yeah.
scene mikuyasutrivia30
: No, about how we might have made this contest a little too difficult.
: Oh.
: Well yeah, now I’m thinking about that instead.
: What do you think we should do then? Stick to the plan? Or maybe change things up a bit and ask them questions they might actually be able to answer?
: The latter would probably be ideal since we’ve still gotta fit Sensei into a couple girls who want to be nice to him.
scene mikuyasutrivia31
: No. Try again.
: The schedule. We’ve gotta make sure it happens and stuff.
: Okay, good. Cause what Uta said is impossible and I ain’t fightin’ two losin’ battles in one day.
: Okay, okay. Let’s cool it with all the innuendos and tone it down a bit, alright?
: Ayane, Uta — it was nice stumping them, but let’s stick to easier stuff for now. Nobody wants to spend the rest of their day here.
: I wouldn’t mind.
: Yeah, same. The longer we can postpone being nice to Sensei, the better.
scene mikuyasutrivia32
: I am so loved.
: Could be worse!
mak "One of them could be permanently mean to you because it was a precedent established early on in your relationship! And because
changing the way they act now would be detrimental to the dynamic of you as characters! Which is why it gets super confusing when they suddenly start doing nice things!"
scene mikuyasutrivia33
: You’re literally describing Maya. That’s what Maya is.
scene mikuyasutrivia34
: Yeah. I’m kind of the Babe Ruth of being mean to that useless sack of adolescent fury that never managed to blossom into a fully-grown man.
: Again, where is Io when people start breaking out the baseball stuff?
: Probably with some friggin’ wood in her hands.
scene mikuyasutrivia35
: Well, that’d be a twist. Anyway! I’m gonna start lookin’ up some new questions so we can eventually get outta here.
: Way ahead of you, Uta! I’ve got Miku’s first “fair” question ready to go right now! I’m sure this contest will be over any minute!
scene mikuyasutrivia36
One hour later...
: The score...
: Is zero to zero...
: I didn’t realize it was possible to be this dumb. No offense, Yasu.
: Wh-What about Miku?!
: I want to offend Miku. If we were asking Yasu the same questions we’re asking you, she’d have won by now.
: Oh yeah?! Then go ahead, Ayane! Ask her the last one you gave me! Let’s see how she handles it!
: Yasu, what color are Yumi’s eyes?
scene mikuyasutrivia37
: G...Gray...ish?...
: Ding ding ding! Close enough! Yasu wins and it’s time to move on! Excellent work to everyone! Just not really! Like, really not really!
scene mikuyasutrivia38
: I did it? Really?
: Heck nah! She’s makin’ it up! Ain’t anybody seen Yumi long enough to figure out what color her eyes are! That’s like askin’ what a ghost feels like.
scene mikuyasutrivia39
: Ghosts feel wonderful. Or at least I think that’s what you would call them if you could see the world like me.
: Their touch is like a cold, ethereal emptiness that is both all-consuming and mercilessly generous. I can show you if you close your eyes.
scene mikuyasutrivia40
: O...kaaaaay. But even if she got her last question right, that’s still only one! The game was supposed to go up to five!
scene mikuyasutrivia41
: We really just don’t have all day, Miku. If it makes you feel better, we can play the rest of the game in the hotel later.
: And cut into my time of not engagin’ in knowledgeology? Wanna hear my Yasu impression? Pass.
: The Dorm Wars is still just 30%% complete, Miku. We have plenty of time to mount a comeback.
scene mikuyasutrivia42
: And you’ve got plenty’a time to mount a horse’s wiener, Makoto! You ain’t the one who lost in a rigged game! I’ve got everythin’ to be mad about! Stop the steal!
scene black
: Hm? What? What happened? Is the game over? I thought I heard someone mention-
: And you can go mount one with her! Miku Maruyama — out! I’m gonna go hang out with Io!
: Aww, yay! Here’s hoping she isn’t over-medicated again!
